about: The QWEN38_* knobs the engine extension reads (engine-ext-v1 1.0, unchanged in 1.1): name -> default. The engine's registry (engine/settings.py KNOBS) carries the same names with the same defaults, its owner a frozen label that names TandemApp's file; TandemApp's tandemapp/knobs.py DEFAULTS is the extension's own copy. A knob the extension starts reading is added here in a minor step.
